name: Samba del Tuerto
storyline:
In a village plagued by crows that flocks above people's heads, these birds seem to have developed aggressive behaviour towards people who show their faces in public. For years, people have adopted various theories as to why this happens, and depending on their perspective, some wear a mask to protect themselves whilst others accept their punishment by covering their faces with their hands.

In ‘Samba del Tuerto’, you’ll play as a person of this second group who that, through their fingers, sees the opportunity to defy what they was always told they had to do.
summary: "Samba del Tuerto" is a short narrative video game with voice and text only in Spanish, about the people living in a village haunted by the crows that flock above their heads.
